items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Dickie Wells, he was there, too, once in a while.

ctx.x: Lou Terassi's on 47th Street towards 8th Avenue. I played there with Red Allen and I think Buster Bailey was on that too. And also the other trombone player, Vic Dickinson, Benny Morton --
Dickie Wells, he was there, too, once in a while. It provided work for practically every musician around New York.
